data.completion_memo: Implemented typed ProjectStore-backed Tauri list/get/save/delete document commands with canonical readToken guards and separate post-commit projection/refresh diagnostics. Added project Documents navigation, linked architecture document entries, stable identity/title breadcrumbs, associations/backlinks, task and QA Markdown pickers and exact backlink selection. Dashboard carries Markdown metadata and refreshes external edits; projection settings/status/retry integrated in step31. Fixed narrow-layout task/QA panels so list controls remain usable. Document body is currently safely displayed as text; editable panel follows next phase. Verified TypeScript/Vite and desktop build, diff check, and actual native WebView acceptance on SQLite (target/native-storage/d6d8d0e0-1da7-40b2-b278-8b1af2f1c696) and text (5df2965d-77ec-4210-b93c-b66963a064b3): empty documents, create/full Unicode body, rename refresh, stale token rejection, task/QA reference pickers and direct links, reverse task navigation and protected referenced deletion. Existing native draft/concurrency/navigation baseline also passed. No installed application or live project storage upgraded.

lines:
Execution order: Markdown step 8 of 12. Depends on Adashi task ID 31 (Markdown 07/12 — Generate full Markdown files and link existing architecture shorts). Complete and verify that prerequisite before starting; all earlier Markdown steps are transitively required.

Wire Markdown documents into the actual desktop design workspace using the shared ProjectStore.
Scope:
- Add typed Tauri commands/models for summary listing, complete retrieval, create/update/delete and association editing. Use the same readToken and transaction semantics as MCP; no driver access or authoritative generated-file edits.
- Add a project-level Documents entry so standalone prose is visible, plus Markdown artefact entries in linked architecture scopes. Support stable selection, title display, breadcrumbs and navigation without fabricating C4 parents.
- Add Markdown to task/QA specification pickers and open links directly in the document panel. Display useful associations and reverse backlinks; preserve link order and existing artefact navigation.
- Update dashboard/revision refresh so external MCP or Git changes refresh clean content while preserving dirty selections/drafts and error state.
- Expose projection enablement/output directory/status/retry in the existing relevant settings/status UI without exposing storage internals in the editing flow.
Acceptance:
- Desktop commands and UI navigation work with both SQLite and text, including empty projects, standalone documents, linked documents, title changes, missing-reference diagnostics and backend changes.
- No new document path or title is treated as its authoritative identity, and existing C4/UML/mockup/task/QA navigation remains intact.

Formal design: retrieve the linked owner specifications. The Markdown extension saved on 2026-09-25 is approved design; implementation remains pending until this task is verified.

data.title: Markdown 08/12 — Add desktop document commands, navigation and references
